implementation.resource_plan: SimulationOptions opt-in capacities feed make_spatial_service_plan through visit_global_storage; three aligned immutable snapshots plus one reusable scratch plan are allocated from the bound simulation arena
implementation.cpu_execution: ProductionSpatialRuntime executes stable active-leaf staging, deterministic admission and transfer finalization, one balanced native tree build or topology-preserving refit, bounded canonical queries, validation, publication and commit/abort directly over the Slang CPU adapter's host-native device allocation
implementation.snapshot_policy: one generation-tagged unpublished slot per tick; one tick-level acquire pins publication through all consumers; commit retires the prior slot only after validation; abort never replaces the prior committed token
implementation.legacy_policy: realtime_spatial_enabled defaults false and profile enumeration remains disabled, so legacy creation, memory requirements and schedule selection are unchanged

production_runtime_cases: empty tick publishes once with zero builds and zero refits
sparse rigid capacity with inactive tombstone and crossing query
unchanged full identities select exactly one topology-preserving refit
owner/primitive generation replacement rejects refit and recovers with one build
one-to-one transfer publishes destination XOR source admission
leaf-capacity overflow and malformed identity fail before publication
post-publication identity drift, candidate overflow and envelope escape each reject commit while preserving the prior epoch
same failed tick number can retry and commit without a second update in either attempt
epoch counters are read from the production lifecycle and assert build/refit/publication/query/candidate totals

qualification.result: PASS 100/100 discovered tests; 85 executed pass, 15 explicitly skipped unsupported CPU domain cases
qualification.notes: Includes production spatial runtime, shared spatial service, rigid spatial, schedule/telemetry and production-driver profile-omission regressions
CUDA adapter compiles against the common SimulationRuntime owner and arena plan
Vulkan adapter compiles against the common SimulationRuntime owner and arena plan

limits: F8-33 does not advertise or accept realtime-single-step-v1 through the public API.
The Slang CPU adapter's advertised rigid/query subset has native execution; unsupported CPU fluid, deformable and smoke domains remain explicit capability omissions.
CUDA and Vulkan results here are compile/regression evidence only. F8-34 binds generated GPU dispatches, the full fixed native schedule and telemetry for every compiled adapter.
No physical quality, frame-time or public installed-SDK qualification is claimed; F8-35, F8-36 and the replacement F8-23--30 leaves own those gates.
